title: Mum Called Me For Dinner. She Was At Work. (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, someone called you down for dinner. And your real mum said don't eat it.
You lock your bedroom door. You call Mum. She picks up on the first ring.
"Stay in your room. I'm coming home right now."
You wait. Twenty minutes. The longest twenty minutes of your life.
Downstairs, the voice hums your mum's favourite song.
Then, a car in the driveway. Keys. The front door.
Your mum's footsteps go into the kitchen.
And then, two voices. Both of them hers.
After a long minute, one of them calls you.
You open the door very slowly.
At the bottom of the stairs, Mum is smiling, holding two plates of curry.
"Sit down," she says. "I didn't want it to go to waste."
*You look closer. She's wearing the work badge. But her phone is ringing in her pocket. And the screen says: Mum.
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
